thread:
alex_support: Heads-up P1 from support — 'Veridian Health' trial blocked. SSO failing during redirect (500) and embedded dashboard sometimes 504s. Pilot demo in ~3 hours. Marking for CS escalation.

sara_cs: Thanks @alex_support. Please paste errors + org id and I'll start a short comms script. Also flag renewal-risk if they confirm demo at risk.

alex_support: Org: veridian-health (org_9081), region eu-west-1. Errors: 
```
[2026-03-23T08:12:05Z] ERROR /auth/callback 500 upstream connect failed x-request-id=ab12cd
payload: SAMLResponse missing RelayState
```
Embed: `iframe load 504 after 30s — https://embed.redwood.ai/v1/render?tenant=veridian-health`

linh_se: Quick triage — looks like edge proxy dropped query params on redirects after last edge deploy. I can push a middleware defensive fix in ~50m but fastest mitigation is to rollback the last edge change and purge tenant cache.

ryan_pm: If demo is impacted that pushes them toward competitor proof-of-concept. Prioritize communications and offer immediate alternatives. Sara can you lead comms? I'll standby for exec escalate if needed.

sara_cs: Will do. Draft outbound (short): 
"Hi Sarah — we're investigating an authentication and embed issue that may affect today's demo. Engineering is working a mitigation now. We can run the demo via screen-share at the scheduled time or reschedule. I'll update you in 30 minutes with status. 
Thanks, Sara (Customer Success)"

alex_support: Support created ticket RED-7623 and opened live bridge. deploy-bot: incident log created: INCIDENT-7623 severity=high.

linh_se: Rollback command available: `edgectl rollback --service edge-proxy --to 2026-03-22T19:45:00Z` then `edgectl purge --tenant veridian-health`. I'll execute if we approve. Rolling back should restore RelayState behavior.

sara_cs: Approve rollback. I'll tell customer we're implementing a targeted fix and offering screenshare.

ryan_pm: I'll join the bridge. Also please add a follow-up action to product: investigate why RelayState can be dropped and add test coverage for embedded redirect flows. Tag as urgent.

alex_support: On bridge: confirmed logs show no auth 500s after rollback started. Will monitor for 10m.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT-7623 status=mitigating assigned=linh_se.

linh_se: Rollback completed at +18m, purge done. Quick smoke: auth callbacks 200, embed renders for tenant in eu-west-1.

alex_support: Verified from support console — no 500s in the last 7m. Noted in ticket and will add support reproduction steps.

sara_cs: Sent update to Sarah at +7m after rollback started. She accepted screenshare for demo. Offered to reschedule if any regressions.

ryan_pm: Created backlog item `EMB-1293 - defensive RelayState handler for redirects` and assigned to eng-triage. Added acceptance criteria and test cases.

alex_support: Marked org meta cs_renewal_risk=high and cs_priority=true. Adding timestamped note to health record.

sara_cs: I'll run a 24h check-in with the customer to measure confidence and capture feedback for product research. Adding customer quote to ticket.

linh_se: After action: will prepare a small patch with defensive handling and roll forward when safe. Also will add edge e2e test for redirect query params.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT-7623 updated status=resolved->monitoring.

ryan_pm: Nice triage. Sara please write a short post-incident note with timeline and customer impact for the next CS sync.

sara_cs: Will do and will include raw feedback and the demo outcome. Closing this slack thread for now — will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
